title: Decent
text:
Decent. The bowl and strainer are nice and feel durable. I can see myself using these quite often and will love using them in prepping food. The grater for the top just doesn't seem all that grate (get it?). The blades feel like they aren't quite sharp enough so driving vegetables into it is a cautionary tale.

I would still recommend for the strainer and bowl!
